name: agent-video-gen
description: Turn a prompt about any product into a cinematic 3D product video up to 10 minutes. Product-specific copy, images, and animation, with claim guardrails, rendered straight to MP4.

interface.shortDescription: Make a cinematic product video from a prompt
interface.longDescription: Describe any product and get an on-brand 3D product film up to 10 minutes: a brief, scene copy checked against claim guardrails, product-specific visuals, and an MP4 rendered directly.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch video for my product.
Create a cinematic promo video for this app using the README as the source.
